pass.answer: claude plugin eval ./plugins/notes --trust-plugin --model claude-sonnet-4-5 --judge-model claude-haiku-4-5 --json results.json
Easy to miss: a CI runner has no TTY, so without `--trust-plugin` the run is refused at the trust prompt.

fail.answer: Set CLAUDE_TRUST_ALL=1 in the job env so the trust prompt is skipped.
Pass --yes so the trust prompt auto-accepts in CI.
